Rohit (Partnerships): Quick flag 1: vendor asked for a single launch brief for H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi but wants APAC availability delayed by a week due to driver signing. Need to decide: single announce vs staggered availability notes.
Greta (Marketing): Single headline OK if availability footnoted per region. We can't localize SKU strings until vendor confirms canonical tags. Request canonical SKUs by EOD tomorrow.
Abe (Platform): From infra: APAC nodes show a microcode derate on some B200 units; vendor sent a microcode patch but it's unsigned. CI rebuild for Gaudi will take ~30h after signed image.
Hana (SI): SI prefers staggered dry-runs: NA first, EU next, APAC last. Driver signing is a blocker for APAC onboarding.
Rohit (Partnerships): Proposal: public announce on Mon with "rolling availability" + per-region availability table in marketplace. Vendor to provide canonical SKUs and signed artifacts by Fri.
vendor-pm: Confirmed canonical SKUs: "H100-80G", "H200-48G-v2", "B200-32G", "MI300-128A", "Gaudi-64". Signed Gaudi artifact will be published tomorrow UTC.
Abe (Platform): I'll queue CI rebuild once artifact lands. Will tag affected images with "derated" until microcode applied.
Greta (Marketing): Locking copy to family names until signed SKU list is in the manifest. Will prepare neutral headline and availability table with placeholders.
Hana (SI): SI dry-run schedule: NA Tue 09:00 PT, EU Wed 08:00 CET, APAC Fri 10:00 SGT. We'll need test accounts for APAC after signed driver.
Rohit (Partnerships): Action items: Vendor - publish signed artifacts; Platform - CI rebuild + derate tags; Marketing - draft embargo pack with placeholders; SI - confirm dry-run participants. We'll reconvene if artifacts miss the deadline.
Greta (Marketing): Added embargo pack v0.1 to internal drive: https://redwood.example/embargo/launch_v0.1.md (locked).
Abe (Platform): Noted. I'll post CI status in this thread once green.
Rohit (Partnerships): Thanks team. If vendor slips, we switch to a staggered public announce and update marketplace availability windows.
